verdict_text: YES — the script computes `delta = B @ A` (shapes `[2048,16]@[16,2048]=[2048,2048]`), applies no transpose since `fan_in_fan_out` is false, scales by `lora_alpha/r=2`, adds in float32, and writes back with the original dtype and name, satisfying requirement 1. It never introduces adapter/intermediate tensors into `sd` (requirement 2), leaves all other keys untouched (requirement 3), and all four required checks (32 merges, no `lora_` keys, q_proj shape, 114 total tensors) run as asserts before the sharded write. The sharding routine correctly limits each shard to 512 MiB of tensor data and isolates oversized tensors (embed_tokens, lm_head) alone in their own shard, matching requirement 4.
